circle_yml.string:
version: 2
jobs:
  verify:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/android:2026.08.1
    environment:
    - FLUTTER_VERSION: 3.47.2
    steps:
    - checkout
    - restore_cache:
        keys:
        - flutter-sdk-{{ .Environment.FLUTTER_VERSION }}-v1
    - run:
        name: Install Flutter
        command: |
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" ]; then
            git clone --depth 1 -b "$FLUTTER_VERSION" https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter-sdk"
          fi
          if [ -n "" ]; then
            ACTUAL=$(git -C "$HOME/flutter-sdk" rev-parse HEAD)
            if [ "$ACTUAL" != "" ]; then
              echo "Flutter SDK SHA mismatch: expected , got $ACTUAL" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          "$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" --version
          echo "export PATH=\"$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH\"" >> "$BASH_ENV"
    - save_cache:
        key: flutter-sdk-{{ .Environment.FLUTTER_VERSION }}-v1
        paths:
        - ~/flutter-sdk
    - run:
        name: Get dependencies
        command: flutter pub get
    - run:
        name: Check formatting
        command: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
    - run:
        name: Analyze
        command: flutter analyze
    - run:
        name: Unit tests
        command: flutter test
    - run:
        name: Brand assets in sync
        command: |
          if ! python3 -c "import PIL" 2>/dev/null; then
            pip install --quiet pillow 2>/dev/null \
              || pip3 install --quiet pillow 2>/dev/null \
              || { echo "Pillow unavailable; skipping brand-asset drift check"; exit 0; }
          fi
          python3 tool/generate_brand_assets.py
          git diff --exit-code -- assets/brand android/app/src/main/res marketing/
  build_signed:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/android:2026.08.1
    environment:
    - FLUTTER_VERSION: 3.47.2
    steps:
    - run:
        name: Resolve pinned SDK commit
        command: |
          COMMIT="${FLUTTER_COMMIT:-d3b14c876900e553bc736ca19295fc09e3853e8e}"
          if [ -n "${FLUTTER_COMMIT:-}" ]; then
            echo "Using FLUTTER_COMMIT from project env vars."
          else
            echo "FLUTTER_COMMIT not set; using config-pinned SHA $COMMIT for Flutter $FLUTTER_VERSION."
          fi
          echo "export PINNED_SDK_COMMIT=\"$COMMIT\"" >> "$BASH_ENV"
    - checkout
    - restore_cache:
        keys:
        - flutter-sdk-{{ .Environment.FLUTTER_VERSION }}-v1
    - run:
        name: Install Flutter
        command: |
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" ]; then
            git clone --depth 1 -b "$FLUTTER_VERSION" https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter-sdk"
          fi
          if [ -n "${PINNED_SDK_COMMIT}" ]; then
            ACTUAL=$(git -C "$HOME/flutter-sdk" rev-parse HEAD)
            if [ "$ACTUAL" != "${PINNED_SDK_COMMIT}" ]; then
              echo "Flutter SDK SHA mismatch: expected ${PINNED_SDK_COMMIT}, got $ACTUAL" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          "$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" --version
          echo "export PATH=\"$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH\"" >> "$BASH_ENV"
    - save_cache:
        key: flutter-sdk-{{ .Environment.FLUTTER_VERSION }}-v1
        paths:
        - ~/flutter-sdk
    - run:
        name: Decode upload keystore
        command: |
          echo "$UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > android/app/upload-keystore.jks
          # NB: no heredoc here — that sequence is reserved in CircleCI
          # configs (YAML merge key) and breaks compilation.
          {
            echo "storePassword=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
            echo "keyPassword=$KEY_PASSWORD"
            echo "keyAlias=$KEY_ALIAS"
            echo "storeFile=upload-keystore.jks"
          } > android/key.properties
    - run:
        name: Write google-services.json
        command: echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON" > android/app/google-services.json
    - restore_cache:
        keys:
        - pub-v1-{{ checksum "pubspec.lock" }}
    - restore_cache:
        keys:
        - gradle-v1-{{ checksum "android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties" }}
    - run:
        name: Pub get
        command: flutter pub get
    - save_cache:
        key: pub-v1-{{ checksum "pubspec.lock" }}
        paths:
        - ~/.pub-cache
    - run:
        name: Build signed APK (direct channel)
        command: flutter build apk --release --flavor direct --dart-define="WORKER_API_SECRET=$WORKER_API_SECRET"
    - run:
        name: Build signed AAB (direct channel)
        command: flutter build appbundle --release --flavor direct --dart-define="WORKER_API_SECRET=$WORKER_API_SECRET"
    - run:
        name: Build Play AAB (play channel)
        command: flutter build appbundle --release --flavor play --dart-define="WORKER_API_SECRET=$WORKER_API_SECRET" --dart-define="PLAY_STORE_BUILD=true"
    - save_cache:
        key: gradle-v1-{{ checksum "android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties" }}
        paths:
        - ~/.gradle/wrapper
        - ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2
    - run:
        name: Normalize artifact names
        command: |
          # Gradle names the APK with the synced version
          # ("Curated Feeds v<version>.apk"); strip it for the
          # version-independent artifact path. Branch builds have no tag.
          cd build/app/outputs/apk/direct/release
          mv "Curated Feeds v"*.apk curated-feeds-direct.apk
          ls -l
    - store_artifacts:
        path: build/app/outputs/apk/direct/release/curated-feeds-direct.apk
        destination: curated-feeds-direct.apk
    - store_artifacts:
        path: build/app/outputs/bundle/directRelease/app-direct-release.aab
        destination: app-direct-release.aab
    - store_artifacts:
        path: build/app/outputs/bundle/playRelease/app-play-release.aab
        destination: app-play-release.aab
workflows:
  ci:
    jobs:
    - verify
    - build_signed:
        requires:
        - verify
        upstream:
          verify:
          - success
  version: 2

actions.name: Install Flutter
actions.bash_command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 -b "$FLUTTER_VERSION" https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter-sdk"
fi
if [ -n "" ]; then
  ACTUAL=$(git -C "$HOME/flutter-sdk" rev-parse HEAD)
  if [ "$ACTUAL" != "" ]; then
    echo "Flutter SDK SHA mismatch: expected , got $ACTUAL" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
"$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin/flutter" --version
echo "export PATH=\"$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH\"" >> "$BASH_ENV"
